models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description: Core system channels representing different seller communities or market segments. Channels organize the overall marketplace structure and enable multiple independent market communities to operate within the platform. Each channel has its own configuration for commission rates, policies, and branding.

plainFields.name: channel_code
plainFields.description: Unique channel identifier code in format like CHANNEL_PRIMARY, CHANNEL_LUXURY, etc. Used in URLs and system references. Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: channel_name
plainFields.description: Display name for the channel shown to customers and sellers. Example: 'Primary Marketplace', 'Premium Store', 'Local Sellers'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the channel's purpose and positioning. Helps sellers understand which channel suits their business. Maximum 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: base_commission_rate
plainFields.description: Default commission percentage (0-100) charged to sellers in this channel. Example: 10.5 means 10.5% commission. Specific product categories can override this.

plainFields.name: min_order_value
plainFields.description: Minimum order value in platform currency required for orders in this channel. Prevents very small orders. Example: 100.00

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this channel is currently active and accepting new sellers and orders. Inactive channels may have read-only access.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order for displaying channels in user interfaces. Lower numbers appear first. Used for UI ordering, not business logic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this channel was created in the system. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this channel was last updated. Updated whenever any channel field changes. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description: Organizational sections within channels that group related product categories. Sections provide a second-level organization hierarchy between channels and specific product categories. Enables structured navigation for customers browsing products. Example sections: Electronics, Clothing, Home & Garden.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent channel this section belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}

plainFields.name: section_code
plainFields.description: Unique section identifier code within a channel. Format: SECTION_ELECTRONICS, SECTION_FASHION. Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: section_name
plainFields.description: Display name for the section shown in navigation and category browsing. Example: 'Electronics & Gadgets'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the section's scope and types of products included. Helps customers understand what products are in this section. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: section_image_url
plainFields.description: URL to an image/icon representing this section for visual display in category navigation. Optional visual identifier.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order for displaying sections within parent channel. Lower numbers appear first in UI navigation.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this section is currently active. Inactive sections are hidden from customer view but preserved for historical data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this section was created. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this section was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description: Product categories that organize the product catalog into hierarchical browsing structure. Categories enable customers to navigate and discover products. Categories can be nested in a tree structure where each category may have a parent category. Examples: Smartphones, Laptops, Clothing, Shoes, Accessories. Used for both customer browsing and seller product organization.

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to parent category in hierarchical structure for nested categories. Null if this is a top-level category. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}

plainFields.name: category_code
plainFields.description: Unique category identifier code used internally. Format: CAT_ELECTRONICS, CAT_SMARTPHONES, etc. Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: category_name
plainFields.description: Display name for the category shown in navigation and product listings. Example: 'Smartphones', 'Laptop Computers'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: category_slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly slug for SEO and navigation URLs. Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens. Example: 'smartphones', 'laptop-computers'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of products in this category. Displayed on category landing page. Maximum 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: category_image_url
plainFields.description: URL to an image/icon representing this category for visual display in navigation and category pages.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order for displaying categories at same hierarchy level. Lower numbers appear first in navigation.

plainFields.name: product_count
plainFields.description: Denormalized count of active products in this category (includes products in subcategories). Updated when products are added/removed from category. Used for display efficiency.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this category is currently visible to customers. Inactive categories are hidden but preserved for historical data and existing product references.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_category_attributes
models.description: Configurable attributes that products in a specific category can have. Attributes define the possible variants (colors, sizes, materials, etc.) that products in a category can use. Enables structured product variant management and customer filtering. Example: In Clothing category, attributes might be Color, Size, Material, Style.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the category these attributes are available for. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}

plainFields.name: attribute_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for this attribute within the category. Format: ATTR_COLOR, ATTR_SIZE, ATTR_MATERIAL. Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: attribute_name
plainFields.description: Display name for the attribute. Example: 'Color', 'Size', 'Material'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: attribute_type
plainFields.description: Data type of attribute values: 'text' (free text), 'number' (numeric values), 'selection' (predefined options from attribute_values), 'boolean' (true/false toggle). Determines how attribute values are managed and displayed.

plainFields.name: attribute_values
plainFields.description: JSON array of predefined values for selection-type attributes. Example: ["Red", "Blue", "Green"] for color. Null for text/number types. Stored as JSON string.

plainFields.name: is_required_for_variant
plainFields.description: Whether products in this category MUST specify a value for this attribute when creating variants. Mandatory attributes for variant definition.

plainFields.name: is_filterable
plainFields.description: Whether customers can filter products by this attribute in category view. Affects customer-facing filtering options.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order for displaying attributes in variant selector and product forms. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute was created. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description: Global platform configuration settings for feature toggles, system behavior, and operational policies. Single-purpose configuration table storing key-value pairs that control platform-wide behavior. Examples: enable/disable review system, enable/disable wishlist feature, maximum cart items, etc.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier. Format: 'feature_reviews_enabled', 'feature_wishlist_enabled', 'max_cart_items', 'default_order_timeout_minutes'. Maximum 100 characters. Used as primary identifier for lookups.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value as string. Interpretations: 'true'/'false' for boolean flags, numeric strings for numbers, JSON for complex objects. Stored as text for flexibility. Maximum 5000 characters.

plainFields.name: config_type
plainFields.description: Data type indicator: 'boolean', 'integer', 'decimal', 'string', 'json'. Helps with value interpretation and validation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of this configuration's purpose and expected values. Helps admins understand what each setting controls. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: is_editable
plainFields.description: Whether admins can modify this configuration from the admin panel. Some system-critical configs may be read-only. Controls admin UI visibility.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was created. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_system_settings
models.description: System-wide operational settings for business rules, policies, and limits. Stores global business settings like minimum order values, maximum product price, commission structures, default timeouts, and policy parameters. Unlike configurations which are feature toggles, settings are business rule values.

plainFields.name: setting_name
plainFields.description: Identifier for this setting. Format: 'minimum_order_value', 'maximum_product_price', 'default_commission_rate', 'payment_timeout_minutes', 'order_cancellation_window_hours'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: setting_value
plainFields.description: Value for this setting as string. Numeric settings stored as numeric strings, currency amounts include decimal point. Maximum 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: setting_unit
plainFields.description: Unit of measurement if applicable. Examples: 'currency', 'minutes', 'hours', 'days', 'percentage', 'units'. Helps interpret numeric values. Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of what this setting controls and why it matters. Helps admins understand business impact. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: min_value
plainFields.description: Minimum allowed value for this setting if numeric. Used for validation when setting is updated. Null for non-numeric settings.

plainFields.name: max_value
plainFields.description: Maximum allowed value for this setting if numeric. Used for validation when setting is updated. Null for non-numeric settings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this setting was created. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this setting was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_supported_countries
models.description: Registry of countries supported by the platform for shipping, tax, and regulatory purposes. Defines which countries are available for customer addresses, seller registration, and shipping destinations. Each country entry includes tax rates, shipping info, and operational flags.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'IN', 'JP'). Used for all country references throughout the system. Exactly 2 uppercase letters.

plainFields.name: country_name
plainFields.description: Full country name as displayed to users (e.g., 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'India'). Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this country (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'INR'). Used for pricing and financial transactions. Exactly 3 uppercase letters.

plainFields.name: tax_rate
plainFields.description: Default VAT/sales tax rate as percentage (0-100). Example: 15.5 for 15.5% tax. Applied to orders shipping to this country unless category-specific rate exists.

plainFields.name: postal_code_format
plainFields.description: Regular expression pattern for validating postal codes in this country. Example: '^[0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?$' for US zip codes. Used in address validation.

plainFields.name: is_shipping_available
plainFields.description: Whether the platform can ship orders to this country. Used to determine available shipping destinations for customers.

plainFields.name: is_seller_registration_allowed
plainFields.description: Whether sellers can register and operate from this country. May be false for countries with regulatory restrictions.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this country is currently active on the platform. Inactive countries are hidden from selection but historical data is preserved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country was added to the system. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country configuration was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_carriers
models.description: Shipping carriers available on the platform for order fulfillment. Registry of carrier integrations including courier services, postal services, and logistics providers. Stores carrier information, API endpoints, tracking URL formats, and operational details for carrier integration.

plainFields.name: carrier_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for this carrier used in system references. Format: 'CARRIER_FEDEX', 'CARRIER_UPS', 'CARRIER_DHL'. Maximum 50 characters. Used for internal references, not display.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Display name of the shipping carrier shown to customers and sellers. Example: 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'DHL Express'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: api_endpoint
plainFields.description: API endpoint URL for carrier tracking and rate queries. Used by system to integrate with carrier systems. Example: 'https://api.fedex.com/v1/'. May be null for manual carriers.

plainFields.name: api_key
plainFields.description: Encrypted API key or credentials for carrier API authentication. Stored encrypted in database. Decrypted only when needed for API calls. Null if no API integration.

plainFields.name: tracking_url_format
plainFields.description: URL template for customer tracking pages. Format: 'https://tracking.fedex.com/tracking?tracknumbers={TRACKING_NUMBER}'. {TRACKING_NUMBER} is placeholder for actual tracking number.

plainFields.name: supported_countries_json
plainFields.description: JSON array of ISO country codes this carrier operates in. Example: '["US", "CA", "MX"]'. Used to filter available carriers by destination.

plainFields.name: service_types
plainFields.description: JSON array of service types offered (Standard, Express, Overnight, etc.). Format: '["Standard", "Express", "Overnight"]'. Used for service selection during shipping.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this carrier is currently available for shipping. Inactive carriers are hidden from seller selections.

plainFields.name: is_api_integrated
plainFields.description: Whether carrier has active API integration for tracking and rate quotes. False means manual tracking number entry required.

plainFields.name: sync_interval_minutes
plainFields.description: Frequency (in minutes) to poll carrier API for tracking updates. Example: 120 = check every 2 hours. Null or 0 means no automatic syncing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this carrier was added to the system. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this carrier configuration was last updated. ISO 8601 format with timezone.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Core customer entity representing end-user shoppers. Stores essential customer account information including authentication credentials, email verification status, and account lifecycle management. Customers can browse products, manage shopping carts, place orders, and leave product reviews.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's unique email address used for account login and communication. RFC 5322 format validated. Serves as the primary authentication identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed customer password using bcrypt with minimum 10 salt rounds. Never stored in plain text. Used for login authentication.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Customer's first name (1-100 characters). Used for personalization in communications and order confirmations.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Customer's last name (1-100 characters). Used for personalization in communications and order confirmations.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's phone number in international or local format. Optional contact method for delivery and customer service purposes.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the customer's email address has been verified. Required to be true before customer can place orders. Email verification prevents unauthorized account creation.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Current customer account status: 'active', 'email_unverified', 'suspended', or 'deactivated'. Determines account access level and order placement eligibility.

plainFields.name: failed_login_attempts
plainFields.description: Count of consecutive failed login attempts. Used for security lockout mechanism. Resets to 0 on successful login. Triggers 15-minute lockout after 5 failures.

plainFields.name: locked_until
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when account lockout expires after excessive failed login attempts. Null if account is not currently locked. Used to enforce 15-minute security lockout period.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when the customer registered on the platform.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last account modification (profile update, password change, etc.). Updated whenever customer information is modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates customer account has been deactivated. Null for active accounts. Enables account recovery and audit trail maintenance.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for customers. One session per active device/browser. Records connection context (IP, URL, referrer) for security tracking and fraud detection. Session expires after 30 days of inactivity. Enables stateless authentication via JWT tokens while maintaining optional server-side session records.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Links session to the authenticated customer.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for security tracking, anomaly detection, and fraud prevention.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (HTTP referrer) indicating the page or service from which authentication occurred. Stored for security audit and access pattern analysis.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the source page that initiated the session. Used for tracking where customers came from during authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when authentication session was established.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp indicating when the session ended (either due to timeout, logout, or explicit termination). Null for active sessions. Sessions default to 30-day expiration.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_addresses
models.description: Customer delivery and billing addresses. Customers can save multiple addresses (maximum 10) for convenient checkout. Each address includes recipient name, complete address details, and delivery/billing designation. Addresses are profile-related data essential for order fulfillment and customer convenience.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Associates address with the customer account.

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: User-friendly address label (e.g., 'Home', 'Work', 'Apartment'). Max 50 characters. Helps customer identify which address to use during checkout.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Full name of the person to receive the delivery. 2-100 characters. Used on shipping labels and delivery confirmation.

plainFields.name: street_address_line_1
plainFields.description: Primary street address line. 5-200 characters. Includes street number, name, and building/unit details as needed.

plainFields.name: street_address_line_2
plainFields.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or additional location details. Optional. Max 200 characters.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or municipality name. 2-100 characters. Validated against known cities in the selected country.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or regional subdivision code/name. 2-50 characters. Format validated per country requirements.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal/ZIP code. Format varies by country (5-20 characters). Validated against country's postal system requirements for accurate delivery.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'JP'). Determines tax jurisdiction, shipping options, and address format validation rules.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for delivery. Validated international or local format. Used by carrier for delivery coordination and customer contact.

plainFields.name: is_default_shipping
plainFields.description: Flag indicating this is the customer's default shipping address. Used to pre-populate checkout shipping field. Only one address per customer can have this set to true.

plainFields.name: is_default_billing
plainFields.description: Flag indicating this is the customer's default billing address. Used to pre-populate checkout billing field. Only one address per customer can have this set to true.

plainFields.name: address_type
plainFields.description: Address type classification: 'shipping', 'billing', or 'both'. Determines whether address is used for delivery, payment, or both purposes.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Flag indicating address has been validated against address verification service. Verified addresses are more reliable for delivery success.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Address creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when customer saved this address.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last address modification. Updated when customer edits address details or changes default designation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates address has been deleted by customer. Null for active addresses. Preserves historical order references.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Core seller entity representing merchants/vendors operating on the platform. Stores seller business identity, authentication credentials, verification status, and account lifecycle. Sellers list products, manage inventory, fulfill orders, and receive payments. Must complete verification before selling.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's business email address used for authentication and official communications. RFC 5322 format validated. Unique across all seller accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed seller password using bcrypt with minimum 10 salt rounds. Never stored in plain text. Used for seller dashboard login authentication.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Seller's legal business name (2-200 characters). Used for business identification and displayed to customers on seller profile and product listings.

plainFields.name: business_registration_number
plainFields.description: Official business registration/license number from relevant government authority. Used for seller verification and compliance purposes. Format varies by jurisdiction.

plainFields.name: tax_identification_number
plainFields.description: Tax ID, VAT number, or equivalent tax identifier. Required for commission calculation and regulatory compliance. Format varies by country.

plainFields.name: primary_contact_name
plainFields.description: Name of primary contact person for the seller business. Used for verification and communication purposes.

plainFields.name: primary_contact_phone
plainFields.description: Primary contact phone number in valid international or local format. Used for seller verification and urgent business communications.

plainFields.name: business_address
plainFields.description: Complete business address matching registration documents. 5-200 characters. Used for seller verification and official correspondence.

plainFields.name: correspondence_address
plainFields.description: Official correspondence address for legal communications. May differ from business address. Used for formal notices and regulatory correspondence.

plainFields.name: business_description
plainFields.description: Description of seller's business and products (50-500 characters). Displayed on seller profile to help customers understand the business.

plainFields.name: store_name
plainFields.description: Store/brand name for display (2-100 characters). Shown to customers on product listings and seller profile. May differ from legal business name.

plainFields.name: verification_status
plainFields.description: Seller verification lifecycle state: 'pending_email_verification', 'pending_approval', 'active', 'verification_rejected', 'permanently_banned'. Controls seller dashboard access and product listing ability.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Current account status: 'active', 'suspended', 'deactivated', 'terminated'. Determines if seller can list products and fulfill orders.

plainFields.name: failed_login_attempts
plainFields.description: Count of consecutive failed login attempts. Resets to 0 on successful login. Triggers 15-minute lockout after 5 failures for security.

plainFields.name: locked_until
plainFields.description: Timestamp when login lockout expires after excessive failures. Null if account not locked. Used to enforce 15-minute security lockout.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when seller applied to the platform.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last account modification (profile update, status change, verification, etc.).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates seller account has been deactivated or terminated. Null for active accounts. Preserves seller history and order records.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for sellers. One session per active device/browser. Records connection context (IP, URL, referrer) for security monitoring. Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity. Enables secure seller dashboard access while maintaining audit trail of login activity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Links session to the authenticated seller.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for seller security tracking and suspicious activity detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL indicating the seller dashboard or service endpoint where authentication occurred. Stored for security audit.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating source page for the session. Used for tracking seller access patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when seller authenticated and session was established.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. When set, indicates session has ended (logout or timeout). Null for active sessions. Default 30-day expiration.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profiles
models.description: Extended seller profile information including store branding, policies, and business metadata. Stores seller customization options like logo, banner images, return policy, shipping policy, and business hours. Enables sellers to personalize their storefront and communicate their policies to customers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Associates profile with the seller account. 1:1 relationship.

plainFields.name: store_url_slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier for seller's store (alphanumeric with hyphens, max 50 characters). Used to create seller storefront URL: store.com/seller/{slug}. Must be unique.

plainFields.name: store_logo_url
plainFields.description: URL to seller's store logo image for display on storefront. Image should be 2MB max, JPEG or PNG format with minimum 200x200 pixels resolution.

plainFields.name: store_banner_url
plainFields.description: URL to seller's store banner image displayed at top of storefront. Image should be 5MB max, JPEG or PNG format, recommended dimensions 1200x300 pixels.

plainFields.name: store_description
plainFields.description: Seller's store description for public display (max 500 characters). Shown on seller profile to help customers understand the business.

plainFields.name: return_policy
plainFields.description: Seller's return and refund policy text (max 2000 characters). Displayed to customers during checkout and on seller profile. Communicates return window and conditions.

plainFields.name: shipping_policy
plainFields.description: Seller's shipping policy and carrier information (max 2000 characters). Displayed to customers explaining shipping methods, costs, and delivery timeframes.

plainFields.name: cancellation_policy
plainFields.description: Seller's order cancellation policy (max 2000 characters). Explains conditions under which orders can be cancelled and any associated fees or restrictions.

plainFields.name: contact_email
plainFields.description: Seller's public contact email for customer inquiries. May differ from account email. Used for customer communications through the platform.

plainFields.name: contact_phone
plainFields.description: Seller's public contact phone number for customer support. Used when customers need to reach seller directly for urgent issues.

plainFields.name: business_hours
plainFields.description: Seller's customer service business hours (formatted text, max 500 characters). Helps customers understand when seller is available for support.

plainFields.name: website_url
plainFields.description: Link to seller's external business website if they have one. Provides additional information about the seller's operations.

plainFields.name: social_media_links
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted social media profile links (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter). Enables customers to follow and verify seller's presence.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Profile creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when seller profile was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last profile modification. Updated whenever seller updates policies, images, or business information.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_verification_documents
models.description: Documents submitted by sellers for identity and business verification during onboarding. Stores references to uploaded documentation (business license, tax certificates, ID proofs, address verification). Enables platform to verify seller legitimacy and comply with regulatory requirements.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Associates verification documents with the seller account.

plainFields.name: document_type
plainFields.description: Type of verification document submitted: 'business_license', 'tax_certificate', 'identity_proof', 'address_verification', 'bank_verification'. Determines what the document proves.

plainFields.name: document_url
plainFields.description: URL to the uploaded document file. Image or PDF format (JPEG, PNG, PDF). Maximum 10MB. Stored in secure cloud storage with access control.

plainFields.name: document_name
plainFields.description: Original filename or descriptive name of the document (max 200 characters). Helps identify which specific document this is.

plainFields.name: issuing_country
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code indicating where the document was issued. Used for validation rules and compliance checking.

plainFields.name: document_number
plainFields.description: Official document number (e.g., business registration number, license number, passport number, tax ID). Used for verification and cross-checking.

plainFields.name: issue_date
plainFields.description: Date when the document was issued. Used to verify document is not expired or suspiciously recent.

plainFields.name: expiration_date
plainFields.description: Document expiration date if applicable. Null if document has no expiration. Used to verify document is still valid.

plainFields.name: verification_status
plainFields.description: Verification status of this document: 'pending_review', 'approved', 'rejected'. Indicates whether admin has reviewed and validated the document.

plainFields.name: verification_notes
plainFields.description: Admin notes regarding verification (max 1000 characters). Explains reason for approval/rejection or requests for specific clarifications.

plainFields.name: verified_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin user ID who reviewed and verified the document. Null if not yet verified. Used for audit trail of verification decisions.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when document was verified by admin. Null if pending verification. Used to track verification workflow timing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Document upload timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when seller submitted the document.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (status change, notes update, etc.).

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description: Platform administrator accounts with system-wide access and control capabilities. Administrators manage users, moderate content, handle disputes, process refunds, and oversee platform operations. Require strong authentication with multi-factor authentication support and comprehensive audit logging.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's unique email address used for authentication and administrative notifications. RFC 5322 format validated. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed admin password using bcrypt with minimum 10 salt rounds. Never stored in plain text. Used for admin dashboard login authentication.

plainFields.name: full_name
plainFields.description: Admin's full name (2-100 characters). Used for identification in audit logs and admin interface.

plainFields.name: admin_level
plainFields.description: Admin permission level: 'super_admin', 'operations_admin', 'content_admin', 'financial_admin', 'support_admin'. Determines feature access and operational scope.

plainFields.name: department
plainFields.description: Admin's department or team assignment (max 100 characters). Used for organizational tracking and access control scoping.

plainFields.name: is_mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether multi-factor authentication is enabled for this admin. Required for enhanced security. Super admins must have MFA enabled.

plainFields.name: mfa_method
plainFields.description: MFA method preference: 'email_otp', 'authenticator_app', or null if MFA not enabled. Admin can authenticate via selected method.

plainFields.name: mfa_secret
plainFields.description: Encrypted MFA secret key for TOTP authenticator app (if using authenticator). Never displayed to admin. Used for OTP code generation.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Current account status: 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended', 'deactivated'. Determines if admin can access the platform.

plainFields.name: failed_login_attempts
plainFields.description: Count of consecutive failed login attempts. Resets to 0 on successful login. Triggers 15-minute lockout after 5 failures for security.

plainFields.name: locked_until
plainFields.description: Timestamp when login lockout expires. Null if account not locked. Used to enforce 15-minute security lockout for excessive failures.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent successful admin login. Used for security monitoring and activity tracking. Null if admin never logged in.

plainFields.name: last_login_ip
plainFields.description: IP address from the most recent login. Used for suspicious activity detection and security investigations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Admin account creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when the admin account was first created by existing admin.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last account modification (role change, MFA setup, status update, etc.).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates admin account has been deactivated. Null for active accounts. Preserves admin action audit trail.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for administrators. Records admin login sessions with connection context for security monitoring. Sessions expire after 8 hours (shorter than customer/seller for security). Multi-factor authentication required. Complete audit trail of all admin access.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to admin's {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}. Links session to the authenticated administrator.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Critical for admin security monitoring and unusual access detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL indicating the admin dashboard endpoint where authentication occurred. Used for access pattern audit.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating source of authentication request. Used for security tracking and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: mfa_verified
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether MFA was successfully completed for this session. Must be true for session to be valid. Required security measure for admins.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp in UTC timezone. Records when admin authenticated and session was established.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. When set, indicates session has ended (logout, timeout, or forced termination). Null for active sessions. Default 8-hour expiration.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_roles
models.description: Role definitions for admin access control and permission management. Defines available roles (Super Admin, Operations Admin, Content Admin, Financial Admin, Support Admin) with descriptions. Enables role-based access control for fine-grained permission management and organizational structure.

plainFields.name: role_name
plainFields.description: Unique role identifier (max 50 characters, lowercase with underscores). Examples: 'super_admin', 'operations_admin', 'content_admin', 'financial_admin', 'support_admin'.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human-friendly role display name (max 100 characters). Shown in admin interface for easy identification. Example: 'Super Administrator', 'Operations Manager'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Role description explaining responsibilities and scope (max 1000 characters). Helps administrators understand what each role can do.

plainFields.name: permission_scope
plainFields.description: Comma-separated list of permission scopes this role has access to. Examples: 'users,sellers,products,orders,payments,disputes,system'. Used for authorization checks.

plainFields.name: can_manage_admins
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this role can create, modify, or delete other admin accounts. Only super admin should have this enabled.

plainFields.name: can_modify_settings
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this role can modify platform-wide settings and policies. Typically only super admin.

plainFields.name: can_override_decisions
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this role can override system decisions (force refund, suspend accounts, etc.). Only higher-level admins should have this.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Role definition creation timestamp in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last role modification (description update, permission scope change, etc.).

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_permissions
models.description: Individual permission definitions for granular access control. Maps specific actions (e.g., 'approve_sellers', 'process_refunds') to permission names. Enables flexible role-based access control by assigning permissions to roles.

plainFields.name: permission_name
plainFields.description: Unique permission identifier (max 50 characters, lowercase with underscores). Examples: 'approve_sellers', 'manage_products', 'process_refunds', 'view_analytics', 'manage_admins'.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human-friendly permission display name (max 100 characters). Shown in permission management interface.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Permission description explaining what action/resource it controls (max 500 characters). Helps admins understand the scope of the permission.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Permission category for organization: 'users', 'sellers', 'products', 'orders', 'payments', 'disputes', 'reporting', 'system'. Used for grouping related permissions.

plainFields.name: risk_level
plainFields.description: Risk level of this permission: 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'. Critical permissions (system config, financial) require higher admin level.

plainFields.name: required_admin_level
plainFields.description: Minimum admin level required for this permission. Examples: 'support_admin', 'operations_admin', 'super_admin'. Limits who can perform the action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Permission definition creation timestamp in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last permission modification.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Core product entity representing items listed for sale. Contains product-level information including name, description, category assignment, and seller ownership. Each product can have multiple variants (SKUs) with different prices, colors, sizes, and other options. Products are the primary discovery unit for customers and serve as containers for variant-specific inventory and pricing management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who owns and manages this product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the primary product category. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique product code identifier assigned by seller (business identifier, not same as SKU which is variant-specific)

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name or title displayed to customers (3-200 characters)

plainFields.name: short_description
plainFields.description: Brief product summary displayed in listings (up to 255 characters)

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Complete product description with detailed information (up to 5000 characters)

plainFields.name: brand
plainFields.description: Manufacturer or brand name (up to 100 characters)

plainFields.name: country_of_origin
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where product is manufactured

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product status: active (visible to customers), inactive (hidden), draft (not yet published), discontinued (permanently removed from sale)

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base product price in platform currency (can be overridden by variant-specific pricing)

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Product weight in kilograms (for shipping calculations)

plainFields.name: warranty_info
plainFields.description: Warranty or guarantee information provided by seller (up to 500 characters)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when product was created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when product information was last modified

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp - product can be restored if deleted within grace period

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description: Product variant (SKU) entities representing specific product options like color, size, material combinations. Each variant has its own price, inventory tracking, and unique SKU identifier. Variants enable customers to select specific product configurations while maintaining normalized data structure (prevents nullable field explosion in main product table). Each product can have multiple variants with independent pricing and inventory.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to parent product containing this variant. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier (6-50 alphanumeric characters with hyphens/underscores, globally unique across all sellers)

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Variant descriptive name (e.g., 'Red - Size M' or 'Blue - 256GB', 3-100 characters)

plainFields.name: attributes_json
plainFields.description: JSON object storing variant attribute key-value pairs (e.g., {"color": "Red", "size": "M", "material": "Cotton"})

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Variant-specific price (overrides product base_price if set)

plainFields.name: cost_price
plainFields.description: Seller's cost for this variant (for profitability tracking, not displayed to customers)

plainFields.name: quantity_on_hand
plainFields.description: Current inventory quantity available for this variant (non-negative integer)

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Variant-specific weight in kilograms (overrides product weight if set)

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Variant status: active (available for sale), inactive (hidden), discontinued (no longer sold)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when variant was created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when variant was last modified

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Product image metadata and references for display in product catalogs and detail pages. Stores image URLs, metadata, and display order. Multiple images per product enable comprehensive product visualization from different angles and contexts. Images are essential for customer product discovery and decision-making.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL or path to the product image file (stored in CDN or cloud storage)

plainFields.name: thumbnail_url
plainFields.description: URL to optimized thumbnail version of the image for listings

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sequence order for displaying images (primary image is typically display_order = 1)

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text for accessibility and SEO (describes image content)

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when image was uploaded

models.name: shopping_mall_product_specifications
models.description: Flexible key-value product specifications storing technical and functional details (e.g., processor type, RAM, color options, materials). Enables products with diverse attributes without schema modification. Specifications are displayed on product detail pages to help customers understand detailed product features and make informed purchasing decisions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product these specifications belong to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: spec_key
plainFields.description: Specification name/key (e.g., 'Color', 'Material', 'Processor', 'Memory', 'Resolution')

plainFields.name: spec_value
plainFields.description: Specification value (e.g., 'Red', 'Cotton', 'Intel i7', '16GB', '1920x1080')

plainFields.name: spec_type
plainFields.description: Data type of specification: text, number, boolean, selection (for filtering and display purposes)

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order in which specification is displayed on product detail page

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories_mapping
models.description: Junction table managing many-to-many relationship between products and categories. Enables a product to belong to multiple categories for improved discoverability (primary category + up to 4 secondary categories). Supports category hierarchy navigation and advanced filtering in product search and browse experiences.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product in this category mapping. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the category this product is assigned to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this is the product's primary category (only one primary per product)

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order in which category should be displayed in category navigation/breadcrumbs

models.name: shopping_mall_product_pricing_history
models.description: Historical audit trail of all product price changes tracking when prices were modified, what they changed to, and who initiated the change. Enables price trend analysis, seller pricing behavior tracking, and dispute resolution by providing complete pricing history. Supports business intelligence on pricing strategies and market dynamics.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product whose price changed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to specific variant if price change is variant-specific (optional, null if product-level change). {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: previous_price
plainFields.description: Price before the change

plainFields.name: new_price
plainFields.description: Price after the change

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for price change (e.g., 'promotion', 'cost_adjustment', 'competitor_response', 'manual_adjustment')

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: Identity of who initiated the price change ('seller', 'admin', 'system')

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when price change was applied

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Point-in-time historical snapshots of complete product state capturing product details, prices, specifications, and variant information at specific moments. Used for audit trails, price history tracking, and dispute resolution. Enables reconstruction of exact product state at any past date. Snapshots preserve product data even after product is modified or deleted.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product this snapshot captures. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description: Product name at snapshot time

plainFields.name: product_description
plainFields.description: Product description at snapshot time

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Product base price at snapshot time

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product status at snapshot time (active, inactive, draft, discontinued)

plainFields.name: product_data_json
plainFields.description: Complete product data serialized as JSON (includes all details, variants, specifications) for historical preservation

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Reason snapshot was created (e.g., 'price_change', 'description_update', 'status_change', 'pre_order', 'dispute_evidence')

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when snapshot was captured (represents the moment in time this snapshot documents)

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_skus
models.description: Current inventory state tracking at the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) level. This table maintains the latest inventory counts for each product variant, including on-hand quantity, reserved units, and committed sales. The SKU-level approach enables precise tracking of variant-specific availability without aggregating across different colors, sizes, or configurations. This table is the authoritative source for real-time inventory status displayed to customers and sellers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to product variant being tracked. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to seller who owns this SKU inventory. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU identifier for this variant (e.g., SHIRT-BLUE-M-001). Maximum 50 characters, alphanumeric with hyphens and underscores allowed.

plainFields.name: quantity_on_hand
plainFields.description: Current physical inventory count available in warehouse. Non-negative integer representing units physically in stock.

plainFields.name: quantity_reserved
plainFields.description: Units temporarily held for active customer shopping carts. These units are unavailable for other customers but not yet committed to orders.

plainFields.name: quantity_committed
plainFields.description: Units allocated to confirmed orders awaiting fulfillment. These represent sold inventory in the fulfillment pipeline.

plainFields.name: quantity_available
plainFields.description: Calculated field: quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved minus quantity_committed. Represents units available for immediate purchase.

plainFields.name: reorder_level
plainFields.description: Inventory threshold that triggers low-stock alerts to seller. When quantity_on_hand falls to or below this level, seller receives notification. Default value 10 units.

plainFields.name: reorder_quantity
plainFields.description: Suggested reorder amount when stock falls below reorder level. Calculated based on sales velocity and storage capacity. Default 50 units.

plainFields.name: warehouse_location
plainFields.description: Physical warehouse or storage location for this SKU (e.g., 'Warehouse A - Shelf 3-B'). Optional field for sellers with multiple fulfillment locations.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Inventory status: 'on_hand' (in stock and available), 'back_order' (temporarily out, reorder pending), 'discontinued' (no longer stocked). Determines product availability to customers.

plainFields.name: last_inventory_count_date
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent physical inventory count or audit for this SKU. Used to identify stale inventory data.

plainFields.name: last_updated
plainFields.description: Timestamp when any inventory field was last modified. Updated on every inventory change (purchase, restock, adjustment).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU inventory record was first created.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_reservations
models.description: Tracks temporary inventory holds for items in customer shopping carts. When a customer adds items to cart, inventory is reserved to prevent overselling during the checkout window. Reservations are automatically released after inactivity timeout (15 minutes default) or converted to committed sales when order is placed. This table enables accurate real-time availability display to multiple concurrent customers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU being reserved. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_skus.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to customer who created the reservation. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shopping_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to shopping cart containing this reservation. {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts.id}

plainFields.name: quantity_reserved
plainFields.description: Number of units reserved for this customer's cart. Positive integer representing held inventory.

plainFields.name: reserved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when inventory was reserved (when customer added item to cart).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when reservation automatically expires if not converted to order. Typically 15 minutes after reserved_at. After this time, inventory is automatically released.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Reservation status: 'active' (currently reserved), 'expired' (reservation timed out), 'released' (customer removed from cart), 'converted' (converted to committed sales). Used to track reservation lifecycle.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_movements
models.description: Immutable audit trail of every inventory change (purchase, restock, return, adjustment, damage). Each movement record captures the complete context of the inventory change including reason, actor, and before/after quantities. This append-only table prevents data loss and enables complete compliance reporting and historical analysis. Movements are never updated, only added; inventory corrections are recorded as new movements.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to SKU affected by this movement. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_skus.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to seller owning the inventory affected by this movement. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to order if movement is purchase-related. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: movement_type
plainFields.description: Type of inventory movement: 'sale' (customer purchase), 'restock' (new inventory received), 'return' (customer returned item), 'adjustment' (manual correction), 'damage' (damaged items removed), 'loss' (inventory loss/theft), 'correction' (system correction)

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Quantity affected by movement. Positive for increases (restock), negative for decreases (sale, damage). Can be zero for no-op movements.

plainFields.name: quantity_before
plainFields.description: Inventory on-hand quantity before this movement. Snapshot of the state before change.

plainFields.name: quantity_after
plainFields.description: Inventory on-hand quantity after this movement. Should equal quantity_before + quantity_change.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Explanation for the inventory movement (e.g., 'Customer order placed', 'Damaged in warehouse', 'Supplier restock received', 'Inventory count discrepancy'). Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: initiated_by_actor_type
plainFields.description: Who initiated the movement: 'customer' (via purchase), 'seller' (via restock upload), 'admin' (manual adjustment), 'system' (automatic process like failed payment release)

plainFields.name: initiated_by_actor_id
plainFields.description: ID of the actor (customer/seller/admin user) who initiated the movement. NULL for system-initiated movements.

plainFields.name: reference_id
plainFields.description: External reference for tracing the movement to source (e.g., order ID, return authorization number, receipt number). Optional context for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: timestamp
plainFields.description: Exact timestamp when inventory movement occurred. Used for complete audit trail and chronological ordering.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional notes about the movement (e.g., 'Items received in damaged condition', 'Partial return accepted'). Maximum 1000 characters, optional.

models.name: shopping_mall_stock_levels_by_location
models.description: Optional multi-location inventory tracking for sellers with multiple warehouses or fulfillment centers. Tracks inventory quantities at specific geographic locations or facilities. Enables sellers to manage stock across warehouses and make location-based fulfillment decisions. Only used if seller has multiple locations; single-location sellers use main inventory_skus table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to SKU tracked at this location. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_skus.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to seller who owns this location inventory. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: location_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for warehouse/fulfillment location (e.g., 'WAREHOUSE_NYC', 'WAREHOUSE_LA', 'FULFILLMENT_CENTER_1'). Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: location_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable location name (e.g., 'New York Warehouse', 'Los Angeles Distribution Center'). Maximum 200 characters.

plainFields.name: location_address
plainFields.description: Physical address of the warehouse location for reference and shipping purposes. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: quantity_on_hand
plainFields.description: Physical inventory quantity at this specific location. Non-negative integer.

plainFields.name: quantity_reserved
plainFields.description: Units reserved for orders at this location (should sum to quantity_on_hand across all locations).

plainFields.name: last_inventory_sync
plainFields.description: Timestamp when inventory was last synchronized across locations. Used to identify stale data.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this location is currently active for fulfillment. Inactive locations may be archived or temporarily closed.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_alerts
models.description: Notifications triggered when inventory reaches threshold conditions (low stock, stockout, overstock). Tracks alert generation and acknowledgment status. Helps sellers proactively manage inventory before stockouts occur. Supports both automatic threshold-based alerts and manual alerts for inventory issues.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to SKU that triggered the alert. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_skus.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to seller who owns the SKU and receives the alert. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: alert_type
plainFields.description: Type of inventory condition triggering alert: 'low_stock' (below reorder level), 'stockout' (zero available), 'overstock' (exceeds warehouse capacity), 'slow_moving' (high inventory but low sales), 'discrepancy' (inventory mismatch)

plainFields.name: alert_level
plainFields.description: Severity level: 'info' (informational only), 'warning' (action recommended), 'critical' (immediate action required). Determines notification urgency.

plainFields.name: current_quantity
plainFields.description: Current inventory level when alert was triggered. Snapshot for reference.

plainFields.name: threshold_quantity
plainFields.description: Threshold that was crossed to trigger this alert (e.g., reorder level, zero for stockout, warehouse capacity limit).

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Alert message description (e.g., 'Stock level fell below reorder threshold of 10 units'). Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when alert was generated.

plainFields.name: acknowledged_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller acknowledged/dismissed the alert. NULL if not yet acknowledged.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether alert is still active or has been resolved. Alert becomes inactive when inventory recovers to normal levels.

plainFields.name: notification_sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent to seller (email, SMS, in-app). Used to track notification delivery.

models.name: shopping_mall_shopping_carts
models.description: Shopping cart metadata for customers. Maintains persistent shopping carts per customer across sessions and devices. Each customer has their active shopping cart that persists independently from orders. The cart represents pre-purchase state and serves as the staging area before checkout. Relates to {@link shopping_mall_shopping_cart_items} containing individual items and to {@link shopping_mall_customers} for ownership.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who owns this cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: cart_status
plainFields.description: Current cart status tracking: 'active' (in use), 'abandoned' (inactive 30+ days), 'converted' (order placed from this cart). Used for cart recovery analytics and cleanup.

plainFields.name: total_items_count
plainFields.description: Denormalized count of distinct items (SKUs) in cart. Updated when items are added/removed. Used for quick display without querying items table.

plainFields.name: total_quantity
plainFields.description: Denormalized sum of all item quantities in cart. Total units across all line items. Updated whenever cart items change.

plainFields.name: subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Denormalized subtotal of all items (sum of unit_price × quantity for all items). Calculated value updated when items are modified. Does not include taxes or shipping.

plainFields.name: estimated_total_amount
plainFields.description: Estimated total with taxes and shipping. Recalculated based on shipping address and method. Used for display purposes before final checkout calculation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was created for this customer. Records cart creation time for analytics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent modification to cart (item added/removed/quantity changed). Tracks last activity for abandonment detection and idle timeout.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if cart is active, populated when cart is archived. Enables cart recovery and historical analysis.

models.name: shopping_mall_shopping_cart_items
models.description: Individual line items within shopping carts. Represents selected products with chosen variants (color, size, etc.) and quantities. Each cart item is a specific product variant with customer's quantity selection. Relates to {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts} (parent cart), {@link shopping_mall_products} (product reference), and {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} (specific SKU chosen). Tracks selected options and timestamps for each item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent shopping cart. {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product being added to cart. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific product variant (SKU) selected. Customer chose this specific color/size/option combination. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this variant in the cart. Must be positive integer. Customer can have multiple units of same variant in cart.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at time item was added to cart. Snapshot of price to show customer what they will pay. May differ from current product price if product was repriced.

plainFields.name: line_total
plainFields.description: Denormalized line item total: unit_price × quantity. Cached value for quick display. Should match calculated value.

plainFields.name: variant_attributes_snapshot
plainFields.description: JSON snapshot of variant attributes selected (e.g., {"color": "Red", "size": "M"}). Preserves the exact configuration customer selected in case variant options change later.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the cart. Tracks item addition order for analytics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent modification to this cart item (quantity changed, etc.). Tracks item-level activity.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description: Wishlist metadata for customers. Maintains wish lists for future purchase tracking and price tracking. Each customer has one wishlist for tracking products of interest. Similar structure to carts but for aspirational rather than committed purchases. Relates to {@link shopping_mall_wishlist_items} containing individual wish list items and to {@link shopping_mall_customers} for ownership.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who owns this wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: total_items_count
plainFields.description: Denormalized count of distinct items (SKUs) in wishlist. Updated when items are added/removed. Used for quick display of wishlist size.

plainFields.name: total_value
plainFields.description: Denormalized sum of all item prices in wishlist. Represents total value if all items were purchased at current prices. Used for analytics and feature display.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist was created (typically at customer registration). Records wishlist creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent modification to wishlist (item added/removed/price changed). Tracks activity for engagement metrics.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if wishlist is active, populated if wishlist was archived. Enables historical tracking.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Individual items within customer wishlists. Represents products (with specific variants) that customers are interested in purchasing. Each wishlist item is a specific product variant with price snapshot and metadata. Relates to {@link shopping_mall_wishlists} (parent wishlist), {@link shopping_mall_products} (product reference), and {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} (specific SKU). Tracks when item was added and any price changes for notification purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product in wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific product variant (SKU) in wishlist. Customer wishlist-added this specific variant. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: price_snapshot
plainFields.description: Price of the variant when item was added to wishlist. Snapshot to track price changes and notify customer of drops. Allows comparison with current price.

plainFields.name: current_price
plainFields.description: Current price of the variant. Updated periodically from product pricing. Compared to price_snapshot to detect price drops and trigger notifications.

plainFields.name: variant_attributes_snapshot
plainFields.description: JSON snapshot of variant attributes (e.g., {"color": "Blue", "size": "L"}). Preserves exact variant configuration customer selected.

plainFields.name: seller_name_snapshot
plainFields.description: Seller name at time of wishlist addition. Stores seller information for tracking without requiring FK query. May differ if seller name changes.

plainFields.name: priority_level
plainFields.description: Priority level for this wishlist item: 'low', 'medium', 'high'. Helps customer organize wishlist importance. Default is 'medium'.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was added to wishlist. Tracks when customer expressed interest in product.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent change to this wishlist item (price updated, priority changed). Tracks item-level modifications.

plainFields.name: price_drop_notified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer was last notified of price drop for this item. Prevents duplicate notifications. Null if not yet notified.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_recovery_emails
models.description: Tracks abandoned cart recovery email notifications sent to customers. Records when recovery emails are sent, delivery status, and customer interactions. Supports abandoned cart recovery marketing campaigns to re-engage customers with carts left incomplete. Relates to {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts} and {@link shopping_mall_customers}. Used for email campaign analytics and effectiveness tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the abandoned shopping cart. {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer receiving recovery email. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: email_address
plainFields.description: Email address to which recovery email was sent. Stored as snapshot in case customer changes email after recovery is sent.

plainFields.name: email_template_type
plainFields.description: Type of recovery email template used: 'first_reminder' (sent after 1 day idle), 'second_reminder' (sent after 3 days idle), 'final_offer' (sent after 7 days with special discount). Tracks which campaign variant was used.

plainFields.name: cart_value_at_send
plainFields.description: Cart total value at time recovery email was sent. Snapshot for tracking email effectiveness and value recovery metrics.

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when recovery email was sent to customer. Records email dispatch time.

plainFields.name: delivery_status
plainFields.description: Email delivery status: 'pending' (awaiting send), 'sent' (dispatched), 'delivered' (confirmed by email provider), 'bounced' (rejected), 'opened' (customer opened), 'clicked' (customer clicked link). Tracks email campaign performance.

plainFields.name: opened_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer opened the recovery email (if tracked by email provider). Null if email not opened. Used for engagement analytics.

plainFields.name: clicked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer clicked a link in recovery email. Null if link not clicked. Indicates high engagement with recovery campaign.

plainFields.name: cart_recovered_order_id
plainFields.description: Order ID if customer completed purchase from this recovered cart. Links recovery email to successful conversion. Null if recovery unsuccessful (cart abandoned without purchase).

plainFields.name: recovery_success_flag
plainFields.description: Whether recovery was successful (cart_recovered_order_id is not null). True if recovery email led to order completion, false otherwise. Used for campaign effectiveness metrics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this recovery email record was created. Records when recovery campaign entry was made.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Core order records representing customer purchases. Contains order-level data including customer reference, total amount, payment and fulfillment status, shipping address, and order timestamps. This is the primary entity for order management on the platform. Each order may contain items from multiple sellers (multi-seller orders handled through order_line_items).
