Links to customer, payment system, and fulfillment infrastructure. Historical record retention is indefinite for compliance and financial auditing purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique human-readable order number in format ORD-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS-XXXXXX. Used for customer and seller references.

plainFields.name: order_status
plainFields.description: Current order status: pending_payment, payment_confirmed, order_confirmed, preparing_shipment, shipped, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, payment_failed. Status transitions tracked in order_status_history table.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment processing state: pending, processing, authorized, captured, failed, refunded, partially_refunded. Independent of order_status for detailed payment tracking.

plainFields.name: fulfillment_status
plainFields.description: Overall fulfillment progress: not_started, in_progress, partially_shipped, fully_shipped, delivered, cancelled. Aggregated from individual line items.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Order subtotal before discounts, in base currency. Sum of all line item prices. Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount amount applied to order from all sources (promotional codes, platform promotions, seller discounts). Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Total tax amount calculated based on destination address and applicable tax rates. Stored in cents precision. Tax rate is locked at order time and not recalculated.

plainFields.name: shipping_cost
plainFields.description: Shipping cost for this order based on selected shipping method and destination. Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final order total = subtotal - discount_amount + tax_amount + shipping_cost. This is the amount charged to customer. Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for order (e.g., USD, EUR, INR). All monetary amounts in this order use this currency.

plainFields.name: shipping_address
plainFields.description: Shipping address as structured JSON containing: street_line_1, street_line_2, city, state, postal_code, country, recipient_name, phone. Snapshot of customer's selected address at order time.

plainFields.name: billing_address
plainFields.description: Billing address as structured JSON. May differ from shipping address. Snapshot at order time.

plainFields.name: shipping_method
plainFields.description: Selected shipping method (e.g., standard, express, overnight). Determines shipping cost and estimated delivery time.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Estimated delivery date calculated at order creation based on shipping method and destination. May be updated as carrier provides new estimates.

plainFields.name: customer_special_instructions
plainFields.description: Special instructions or notes provided by customer during checkout (max 500 characters). Examples: 'leave at door', 'ring doorbell twice', 'fragile items'.

plainFields.name: internal_notes
plainFields.description: Internal notes visible only to admin and seller. Used for flagging special circumstances, investigation notes, or order-specific context (max 1000 characters).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was placed (ISO 8601 format with timezone). Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last order update (status change, notes added, etc.). Updated on any order modification.

plainFields.name: cancelled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was cancelled (if applicable). Null for non-cancelled orders. Enables tracking cancellation timing.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_line_items
models.description: Individual items within an order. Each line item represents one product variant (SKU) from one seller. Orders can contain multiple line items from different sellers (multi-seller orders). Maintains 1:many relationship with orders table. Stores line-item-specific pricing, quantity, fulfillment status, and seller reference. Enables proper normalization by separating item-level data from order-level data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order containing this line item. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being purchased. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_products.id}. Stored for historical reference (product may be updated or deleted later).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Specific product variant (SKU) purchased. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}. Captures exact variant at time of order.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller fulfilling this line item. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Multi-seller orders have multiple line items with different sellers.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for this specific product variant. Snapshot of SKU at order time.

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description: Product name snapshot at time of order (product may be renamed or deleted later). Used for customer-facing receipts and order history.

plainFields.name: variant_details
plainFields.description: JSON snapshot of variant attributes (color, size, options, etc.) at time of order. Enables customers to remember exact variant purchased.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at time of order in order's currency. Locked in at order creation, not affected by later price changes. Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units ordered for this line item. Must be positive integer.

plainFields.name: line_subtotal
plainFields.description: Line item subtotal = unit_price × quantity before line-item-specific discounts. Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: line_discount
plainFields.description: Discount applied to this specific line item (if any). Stored in cents precision. Used for items with quantity-based discounts.

plainFields.name: line_total
plainFields.description: Line item total = line_subtotal - line_discount. This is the amount for this item in the order. Stored in cents precision.

plainFields.name: item_status
plainFields.description: Fulfillment status of this specific line item: pending, confirmed, picked, packed, shipped, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, returned. Enables tracking individual items in multi-seller orders.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when line item was added to order. Normally same as order.created_at but may differ if order items are added asynchronously.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last line item update (status change, etc.). Enables tracking item-level changes.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_history
models.description: Immutable append-only audit trail of all order status transitions. Captures point-in-time snapshots of status changes with exact timestamp and triggering actor. Enables complete visibility into order lifecycle for customers, sellers, and admins. Each status change creates a new record (never updated or deleted). Used for compliance auditing, dispute resolution, and performance analytics.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order for which status changed. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: Order status before this transition. Null if this is the initial status at order creation.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Order status after this transition. The current status of the order at this point in time.

plainFields.name: status_transition_reason
plainFields.description: Reason or context for status change (e.g., 'payment authorized', 'seller confirmed', 'carrier pickup', 'delivered by carrier'). Helps understand why transition occurred.

plainFields.name: triggered_by
plainFields.description: Actor who triggered the status change: 'customer', 'seller', 'admin', 'system', 'payment_processor', 'carrier'. Identifies source of the transition.

plainFields.name: triggered_by_id
plainFields.description: ID of actor who triggered change (customer_id, seller_id, admin_id, or 'system'). Enables audit trail of specific users.

plainFields.name: duration_in_previous_status
plainFields.description: Number of seconds order spent in previous status before transitioning. Null if first status. Used for SLA tracking and performance analytics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when status transition occurred. ISO 8601 format with timezone. Immutable after creation - defines exact moment of transition.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shipment_mappings
models.description: Junction table linking orders to shipments. Enables mapping between orders and their corresponding shipment records. Supports multi-shipment orders (order split across multiple packages) and multi-order shipments (consolidation). Maintains relationship between order fulfillment and shipping infrastructure.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order being shipped. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Shipment record for this order. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}. One order may have multiple shipments.

plainFields.name: mapping_sequence
plainFields.description: Sequence number if order has multiple shipments. First shipment = 1, second = 2, etc. Enables ordering of multiple packages.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when mapping was created (when shipment was assigned to order). Records when relationship was established.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_tracking
models.description: Order-specific tracking information and details. Maintains current tracking state for orders including tracking number, carrier, estimated delivery, and tracking status. Enables customers to monitor order progress through fulfillment and delivery. Links orders to carrier tracking systems.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order being tracked. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for this shipment. May be multiple numbers if order split across packages (stored as comma-separated list).

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Shipping carrier name (e.g., 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'DHL', 'USPS'). Enables linking to carrier tracking systems.

plainFields.name: carrier_service
plainFields.description: Carrier service type (e.g., 'Ground', 'Express', 'Priority'). Indicates service level selected.

plainFields.name: current_tracking_status
plainFields.description: Latest tracking status from carrier: 'pending_pickup', 'picked_up', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'failed_delivery', 'returned'. Current state of shipment.

plainFields.name: last_tracking_update
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent carrier tracking update. Enables detection of stale tracking data.

plainFields.name: current_location
plainFields.description: Current location of shipment if provided by carrier (city, country, or facility name). JSON format if detailed coordinates available.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery
plainFields.description: Current carrier estimate for delivery (may differ from order's original estimate). Updated as carrier provides new information.

plainFields.name: delivery_confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when delivery was confirmed by carrier or customer signature. Marks completion of shipping phase.

plainFields.name: delivery_exception_reason
plainFields.description: If delivery failed, reason provided by carrier (address invalid, recipient unavailable, refused, weather delay, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when tracking record was created (when shipment was assigned). Marks start of tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last tracking update. Updated whenever carrier provides new tracking information.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_order_preferences
models.description: Customer-specific preferences and settings for their orders. Captures customer's default choices and order-related preferences (shipping method preference, notification settings, etc.). Enables personalization of order experience. Subsidiary table managed through customer account settings.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer whose preferences are stored. Reference to {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. One-to-one relationship per customer.

plainFields.name: preferred_shipping_method
plainFields.description: Customer's preferred shipping method (standard, express, overnight, etc.). Pre-selected in checkout for convenience.

plainFields.name: preferred_payment_method_id
plainFields.description: Customer's preferred payment method ID (reference to payment method in payment system). Pre-selected in checkout.

plainFields.name: use_billing_address
plainFields.description: Whether customer prefers to use billing address same as shipping address. Simplifies checkout.

plainFields.name: order_notifications_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether customer wants order status notifications (email, SMS, push). Controls notification delivery.

plainFields.name: newsletter_opted_in
plainFields.description: Whether customer opted into promotional newsletter. Used for marketing communications.

plainFields.name: gift_preferences
plainFields.description: Gift preferences JSON (gift wrap preference, gift message, delivery timing, etc.). Enables gift order personalization.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when preferences were first created. Marks when customer set up preferences.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last preference update. Tracks when customer last modified settings.

models.name: shopping_mall_payments
models.description: Core payment records for customer orders. Stores order-level payment information including customer, order reference, payment method, and final payment status. This is separate from detailed payment processor transactions to maintain clean separation of concerns between order-level payment state and gateway-level transaction details.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order being paid for. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer making the payment. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method used for this transaction. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Human-readable order number for reference (e.g., ORD-20250115-ABC123)

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Payment amount in platform currency (stored in cents to avoid floating point errors)

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (USD, EUR, INR, etc.)

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Current payment status: pending_payment, payment_processing, payment_confirmed, payment_failed, payment_pending, refund_processing, refund_completed, refund_failed

plainFields.name: payment_method_type
plainFields.description: Type of payment method: credit_card, debit_card, paypal, bank_transfer, digital_wallet

plainFields.name: card_last_four
plainFields.description: Last 4 digits of card (if card payment), masked for security

plainFields.name: cardholder_name
plainFields.description: Name on the payment method

plainFields.name: billing_address
plainFields.description: Billing address provided at payment time (JSON formatted for address components)

plainFields.name: authorization_code
plainFields.description: Authorization code from payment processor if transaction was approved

plainFields.name: transaction_id
plainFields.description: Unique transaction ID from payment processor

plainFields.name: response_code
plainFields.description: Standardized response code from payment processor (00 for success, etc.)

plainFields.name: response_message
plainFields.description: Human-readable response message from payment processor

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Error code if transaction failed (insufficient funds, expired card, etc.)

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Detailed error explanation if transaction declined or failed

plainFields.name: fraud_score
plainFields.description: Risk assessment score from payment processor (0-100, higher = more risky)

plainFields.name: three_d_secure_status
plainFields.description: 3D Secure authentication status: not_applicable, authenticated, attempted, not_enrolled

plainFields.name: idempotency_key
plainFields.description: Unique key for idempotent payment processing to prevent duplicate charges

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: Customer IP address when payment was attempted

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser/device user agent information

plainFields.name: request_timestamp
plainFields.description: When the payment request was received

plainFields.name: authorization_timestamp
plainFields.description: When payment authorization was received from processor

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Payment record creation timestamp

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this payment record

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_transactions
models.description: Detailed payment processor transaction records. Captures every interaction with the payment gateway including authorization, capture, decline, refund, reversal events. Maintains complete audit trail of payment processor responses. Separate from shopping_mall_payments to preserve immutable transaction history while allowing payment status updates.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent payment record. {@link shopping_mall_payments.id}

plainFields.name: transaction_type
plainFields.description: Type of transaction: authorization, capture, decline, refund, reversal, adjustment, chargeback

plainFields.name: transaction_status
plainFields.description: Status of this specific transaction: pending, successful, failed, cancelled

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Transaction amount (may differ from original payment if partial refund, etc.)

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for this transaction

plainFields.name: gateway_transaction_id
plainFields.description: Transaction ID from payment processor

plainFields.name: gateway_reference_id
plainFields.description: Reference ID from payment processor (for linking related transactions)

plainFields.name: authorization_code
plainFields.description: Authorization code if applicable

plainFields.name: response_code
plainFields.description: Response code from payment processor

plainFields.name: response_message
plainFields.description: Response message from payment processor

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Error code if transaction failed

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Error message if transaction failed

plainFields.name: avs_response
plainFields.description: Address Verification System response (if card transaction)

plainFields.name: cvv_response
plainFields.description: CVV verification response (if card transaction)

plainFields.name: request_payload
plainFields.description: Full request JSON sent to payment processor (for audit trail, no sensitive data)

plainFields.name: response_payload
plainFields.description: Full response JSON received from payment processor (for audit trail)

plainFields.name: request_timestamp
plainFields.description: When request was sent to payment processor

plainFields.name: response_timestamp
plainFields.description: When response was received from payment processor

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp

models.name: shopping_mall_refunds
models.description: Refund request and processing records. Tracks lifecycle of refunds from initiation through completion. Separate entity (not nullable fields on payments) enables proper refund state management and audit trail. Refunds can be partial, have multiple statuses, and require approval workflows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original payment being refunded. {@link shopping_mall_payments.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: refund_number
plainFields.description: Unique refund identifier (REF-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX format)

plainFields.name: refund_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for refund: customer_request, payment_failure, seller_cancellation, order_cancellation, return_accepted, dispute_resolution, chargeback, other

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Amount to be refunded (may be less than original payment for partial refunds)

plainFields.name: original_amount
plainFields.description: Original payment amount (for reference)

plainFields.name: refund_status
plainFields.description: Current refund status: initiated, approved, processing, completed, failed, reversed, cancelled

plainFields.name: refund_method
plainFields.description: How refund will be issued: original_payment_method, store_credit, bank_transfer, other

plainFields.name: deduction_amount
plainFields.description: Amount deducted from refund (restocking fee, condition deduction, etc.)

plainFields.name: deduction_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for deduction (e.g., item condition, restocking fee)

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Internal notes about this refund (admin comments, investigation notes, etc.)

plainFields.name: initiated_by
plainFields.description: Who initiated the refund: customer, seller, admin, system

plainFields.name: approved_by
plainFields.description: Admin ID who approved the refund (if applicable)

plainFields.name: initiation_timestamp
plainFields.description: When refund was initiated

plainFields.name: approval_timestamp
plainFields.description: When refund was approved for processing

plainFields.name: processing_timestamp
plainFields.description: When refund processing was initiated with payment processor

plainFields.name: completion_timestamp
plainFields.description: When refund was completed/credited to customer

plainFields.name: expected_completion_date
plainFields.description: Expected date/time refund will appear in customer account

plainFields.name: gateway_refund_id
plainFields.description: Refund ID from payment processor

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_methods
models.description: Customer payment methods stored on file. Tokenized payment references for reuse, avoiding storage of complete sensitive data. Each payment method is linked to a customer and can be marked as primary or deleted. Supports credit cards, digital wallets, and bank accounts.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this payment method. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: payment_method_type
plainFields.description: Type of payment method: credit_card, debit_card, paypal, bank_account, digital_wallet

plainFields.name: payment_token
plainFields.description: Tokenized reference from payment processor (never stores actual card/account data)

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer-friendly name for this payment method (e.g., "My VISA", "PayPal Account")

foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipment being tracked. The {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_moderation_history

models.name: shopping_mall_review_flags

models.name: shopping_mall_return_requests

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated the return request. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_line_item_id

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id

models.name: shopping_mall_return_shipments
models.description: Tracks the physical return shipment journey from customer back to seller. Records carrier, tracking number, and shipping status as return moves through logistics. This is the shipment stage of the return lifecycle.

foreignFields.description: Associated return authorization approval. {@link shopping_mall_return_authorizations.id}

foreignFields.description: Customer initiating the return shipment. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_carrier_id
foreignFields.description: Carrier handling the return shipment (optional). {@link shopping_mall_shipping_carriers.id}

plainFields.name: return_tracking_number

plainFields.name: carrier_name

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_return_inspections
models.description: Records seller's inspection of received return item. Documents item condition, whether condition is acceptable for refund, and any deductions (restocking fees, condition issues). This is the inspection stage after return is received.

foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller involved in the dispute. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.
